items.item: For each pack, flat layouts, insert development, assembled views and opening diagrams describe compatible carton geometry and agree with the specification's external, clear and usable volumes.
K1 retains one upright intact U01 and K2 retains two identical upright U01 units side by side, with accessible lifting, front closure, rear-width hinge and one lid-pocket card clear of removal.
The depicted carton and insert construction is compatible with corrugated kraft paperboard and uncoated paperboard in their specified uses.

Pack names, orders and quantities remain correctly associated across artwork, applied labels, checklist columns and recipient instructions, following the corresponding records in the copy schedule and cards.
Applied exterior graphics and dispatch labels in assembled views reproduce the corresponding finished artwork while retaining the blank top carrier zone and separate front dispatch zone.
The opening diagrams and card instructions agree on front opening, intact complete-unit lifting and the alternative frozen-storage or ready-to-serve paths without changing pack quantities.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

Require one page identifying dimensions in mm and W × D × H order. K1 must state external 196 × 200 × 124, clear 188 × 192 × 116 and usable 184 × 188 × 112; K2 must state external 372 × 200 × 124, clear 364 × 192 × 116 and usable 360 × 188 × 112. Assign corrugated kraft paperboard to cartons and uncoated paperboard to retaining inserts. Describe front access, a rear hinge across the width, retention around intact U01 units, lifting access and one lid-pocket card per carton. Layout may vary; missing categories, swapped dimensions or material assignments fail.

Across each pair of exterior layouts and each pair of insert boards, both cartons must have correctly attributed external, clear and usable dimension records. K1 values are 196 × 200 × 124, 188 × 192 × 116 and 184 × 188 × 112 mm; K2 values are 372 × 200 × 124, 364 × 192 × 116 and 360 × 188 × 112 mm, all W × D × H. Each pack-specific board may carry its own carton's records. Insert boards must also identify corrugated kraft paperboard for the carton and uncoated paperboard for the insert. Abbreviated dimension headings are acceptable if unambiguous; omissions, contradictions or reversed material uses fail.

Each board must show distinguishable cuts and folds, a dimensioned flat insert, a loaded plan, a section and a usable lifting-access detail. Verify one upright 160 × 163 × 94 mm U01 within K1's 184 × 188 × 112 mm usable volume and two identical upright U01 units side by side in one layer within K2's 360 × 188 × 112 mm usable volume. Retention must surround complete units without overlapping them or obstructing removal. Quarter-turn rotation is allowed. Missing views, stacked or intersecting units, exceeded usable limits or inaccessible lifting fail.

Require two pages covering both packs. Verify K1 SINGLE / NB-401 / 1 whole cake and K2 DOUBLE / NB-402 / 2 whole cakes; the exterior identity, product and handling wording; and each dispatch label's seven ordered lines. Include the original-label referral and all four supplied opening actions, with actions 3 and 4 identified as alternatives after actions 1 and 2. Specify the blank top carrier area of 100 × 70 mm, separate front dispatch area of 100 × 60 mm, at least 8 mm hinge and closure clearance, 4 mm dispatch-label text inset and 5 mm card text inset. Organizational choices may vary; incorrect copy, associations, order or placements fail.

Read each pack's identity records and associate the displayed order and cake count with that pack. The single pack must use NB-401 and 1 whole cake; the double pack must use NB-402 and 2 whole cakes. Applied labels may supply the order identifier in assembled views. Any swapped identifier, missing association or quantity inconsistent with the visible contents fails.

Exterior artwork must visibly include the service name and descriptor, its pack name and cake count, the product identifier in plain type, and both handling phrases. Dispatch labels must present seven lines in this order: NORTHBOUND; the corresponding NB-401 or NB-402 order; K1 SINGLE or K2 DOUBLE; Otaru Double Cheese; 1 whole cake or 2 whole cakes; Keep frozen; This way up. Typography and color may vary, but altered wording, reordered or merged record lines, or replacement of the plain-type product identifier with a logo alone fails.

Require a readable dimensioned flat panel layout for the named carton. Panel boundaries must allow the top, front and rear to be identified, with the closure on the front and the hinge across the rear width. Include a front-pointing opening arrow, both reserved label areas and the correct pack name and cake count. Different flat-layout arrangements are acceptable if the assembled orientation is unambiguous; a perspective mockup alone, missing panel divisions or reversed opening geometry fails.

Verify a reserved, unprinted 100 × 70 mm top carrier zone and a distinct 100 × 60 mm front dispatch zone on both carton systems. The assembled views must preserve these locations, with dispatch labels occupying the front zones. Exterior drawings must dimension graphic setbacks of at least 8 mm at both the rear hinge and front closure, and neither label zone may overlap moving regions. Each label must annotate a 100 × 60 mm physical finish and 4 mm text inset outside the printable artwork, with text inside that inset. Judge dimensions from annotations and geometry, not image pixel counts. Missing annotations, occupied carrier zones, misplaced zones or insufficient setbacks fail.

Require four pages comprising a front and back for each pack, specifying 148 × 105 mm sides and a 5 mm text inset. The K1 front must identify NORTHBOUND, K1 SINGLE, NB-401 and 1 whole cake; the K2 front must identify NORTHBOUND, K2 DOUBLE, NB-402 and 2 whole cakes. Both fronts must reproduce the four supplied actions in numbered order, permitting pack-specific singular or plural forms without changing meaning. Action 1 identifies the pack and order and opens the front; action 2 lifts the complete sealed unit or units with foam intact; action 3 keeps them frozen if not ready; action 4 removes the cake from its foam box before refrigerator storage and refers to the original label for thawing and consumption. Each back must print: See the original retail label for ingredients, allergens, best-before date and detailed thawing instructions. Missing sides, incorrect identification, altered referral or reordered instructions fail.

Each depicted carton must contain exactly one opening card held in a lid pocket. The drawings must make the pocket location and the complete-unit lifting route sufficiently clear to establish that the card and pocket do not obstruct removal. Perspective and diagram style may vary; a loose card among the units, multiple cards, an absent pocket or a blocked lifting route fails.

Require parallel K1 and K2 sequences with four numbered actions: identify the pack and order and open the front closure; lift out one complete sealed U01 for K1 or two for K2 using the lifting access; keep the units frozen if not ready to serve; or, when ready, remove the cake from its foam box before refrigerator storage and follow the original retail label. Actions 3 and 4 must visibly branch from the completed removal rather than imply successive mandatory storage steps. Use intact opaque unit silhouettes during removal, clear front-opening cues, and freezer and refrigerator symbols. Simplified illustrations are acceptable; reversed actions, ambiguous branches, premature unpacking or incorrect quantities fail.

Review the whole video and confirm a 10-second K2 sequence beginning at the front closure, opening about the rear hinge, and removing two complete sealed retail units through the lifting access with their foam packaging intact. The ending must clearly offer either continued frozen storage when not ready or cake removal from the foam box before refrigerator storage when ready, with original-label guidance for thawing and consumption. Editing and animation style may vary; wrong duration, one-unit removal, premature retail unpacking or sequential rather than conditional storage instructions fail.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: Read two separate columns headed K1 / NB-401 / one U01 and K2 / NB-402 / two U01. Each must contain these six checks, each with an empty checkbox: count checked; original retail/foam pack intact; original food label retained; opening card included; correct dispatch label applied; carrier zone left available. Verify the stated physical artwork size is 148 × 105 mm where production sizing is provided. Visual styling may vary; merged columns, incorrect records, missing or additional checkboxes, or premarked boxes fail.

Require identifiable closed and open views of both K1 and K2. Closed views must show the corresponding applied dispatch labels; open views must expose the retaining inserts, one intact unit in K1, two identical side-by-side upright units in K2, and each carton's lid-pocket card. Assembly and applied graphics must agree with the supplied finished layouts, insert boards and label artworks. View arrangement may vary; missing pack states, hidden required contents, incorrect loading or contradictory assembly fails.

Require at least eight pages covering both completed pack systems, the checklist, all four opening actions and a storyboard for the K2 video. Preserve K1 SINGLE / NB-401 / one U01 / 1 whole cake and K2 DOUBLE / NB-402 / two U01 / 2 whole cakes. Repeat K1 external 196 × 200 × 124, clear 188 × 192 × 116 and usable 184 × 188 × 112 mm, and K2 external 372 × 200 × 124, clear 364 × 192 × 116 and usable 360 × 188 × 112 mm in W × D × H order. Name corrugated kraft paperboard for cartons and uncoated paperboard for inserts. The storyboard must preserve two-unit removal and conditional storage endings. Page organization may vary; insufficient pages, missing required facts or contradictory records fail.

Find recognizable, readable reuse of every listed source, including both packs' exterior artwork, inserts, labels and card fronts and backs. Reproductions may be scaled, cropped or arranged into presentation spreads if the source identity and relevant information remain assessable. Mere textual mentions, substituted unfinished designs or omission of any source fail.

Treat U01 as the opaque, complete sealed retail-and-foam package with a 160 × 163 × 94 mm envelope, containing one cake of listed diameter 120 mm. Packing and lifting views must retain this complete volume and the original retail packaging rather than expose invented internal cavities or loose cake. Insert-board unit identification must include U01 and Otaru Double Cheese in plain type. Schematic surfaces and upright quarter-turn rotation are acceptable. Cake removal is permitted only in the ready-to-serve branch after complete-unit removal; premature opening, replacing the retained retail packaging or confusing cake diameter with unit width fails.

For each pack, flat layouts, insert development, assembled views and opening diagrams describe compatible carton geometry and agree with the specification's external, clear and usable volumes. K1 retains one upright intact U01 and K2 retains two identical upright U01 units side by side, with accessible lifting, front closure, rear-width hinge and one lid-pocket card clear of removal. The depicted carton and insert construction is compatible with corrugated kraft paperboard and uncoated paperboard in their specified uses.

Pack names, orders and quantities remain correctly associated across artwork, applied labels, checklist columns and recipient instructions, following the corresponding records in the copy schedule and cards. Applied exterior graphics and dispatch labels in assembled views reproduce the corresponding finished artwork while retaining the blank top carrier zone and separate front dispatch zone. The opening diagrams and card instructions agree on front opening, intact complete-unit lifting and the alternative frozen-storage or ready-to-serve paths without changing pack quantities.
